claim: For the complete bipartite graph \(K_{4,4}\), let \(M_2(K_{4,4})\) be the simplicial complex whose vertices are the sixteen edges of \(K_{4,4}\) and whose faces are the edge sets in which every graph vertex has degree at most \(2\). Then \(M_2(K_{4,4})\simeq\bigvee^{15}S^5\).
integrity: The homotopy conclusion is supported by an exhaustive finite acyclic-matching certificate; mod-2 homology and Euler characteristic are independent finite cross-checks, not replacements for the homotopy proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the degree-two matching complex of K_{4,4}.
No general formula for M_2(K_{n,n}) with n>4 is claimed.
No equivariant homology decomposition or shellability result is claimed.
title: The two-matching complex of \(K_{4,4}\) is a wedge of fifteen five-spheres
